title: "My First Weeks in MDS"
author: "Kuangzi Li"
date: 2026-09-10
---

## Getting Started

I was unable to attend the official orientation, so my introduction to the MDS
program was a little different from that of many of my classmates. I gradually
became familiar with the program by meeting my cohort, exploring the UBC campus,
and learning how the courses are organized. It was exciting to meet classmates
from many different academic and professional backgrounds.

## The First Week of Classes

The first week was fast-paced and more intensive than I expected. We began
working with R, Python, statistics, command-line tools, and collaborative
workflows. I was especially surprised by how quickly the courses moved from
basic concepts to practical exercises. Although I already had experience in AI
engineering, the program introduced me to a more systematic way of working with
data and communicating analytical results.

## Looking Ahead

I am currently adjusting to the workload and learning how to manage several
short assignments at the same time. The pace can be challenging, but I am
becoming more comfortable with it. Over the coming months, I hope to strengthen
my foundations in statistics and machine learning while connecting them with
my previous experience building AI agents. I also look forward to exploring
Vancouver and getting to know my classmates better.
